verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance platform, so AI-drafted security questionnaire answers are a fair capability to ask about. However, nothing in the evidence documents questionnaire ingestion or AI-drafted answers grounded in controls or a knowledge base. The related evidence covers other features: Fieldwork AI evidence collection, a Trust Center, and a vCISO who helps with security reviews, none of which is questionnaire automation.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
